description: Produces a launch plan built for Artificial Intelligence (AI) products and features: a demo-led narrative, waitlist and early-access design with capacity gates, a channel plan for Product Hunt, Hacker News, LinkedIn, and developer communities, evaluation-backed proof, a day-0 to day-30 runbook, and pre-written failure-mode communications. Use when launching an AI product, agent, or AI feature; planning a waitlist or private beta for a model-backed product; preparing for a Product Hunt or Hacker News launch; or de-risking a launch where output quality, cost, or safety could go wrong in public.
